desc: Tall pines close around you. The air smells of wet bark and cold iron. A path leads east.

desc.then: Your lantern throws a small warm circle on the ground.

desc: The trees open into a mossy clearing. A stone well stands at the centre, a rusted lantern hanging from its post.

desc.then: You are badly hurt. You should rest before going on.

desc: A small stone shrine, covered in ivy. Offerings sit on the altar: a coin, a feather, a knuckle of chalk.

desc.then: The shrine hums quietly. It has accepted your gift.
